answer: Publish the work history. Lock each entry for 30 days before it counts. Announce every failure on the public feed. Let idle identities lose standing every epoch. A clone starts with an empty history and must wait the full 30 days before its first entry counts, while a failed audit wipes the record. The marble of a manufactured past takes a month to carve, the vine of referrals grows slowly, and the lotus of a farm's first payout stays closed through the lock.
